relationships.subject: sodium hyaluronate
relationships.evidence_quote: the levels of MMP-3, MMP-9, interleukin (IL)-1, and tumor necrosis factor α (TNF-α) in the joint fluid of patients in the Exp group after treatment were markedly lower

key_findings: Nimesulide plus intra-articular sodium hyaluronate lowered joint fluid MMP-3, MMP-9, IL-1, TNF-alpha and pain scores versus nimesulide alone in traumatic knee OA
